name: Oxide: Survival Island
description:
Bem-vindo ao Oxide: Survival Island, o simulador de sobrevivência multijogador definitivo que te deixa em uma ilha brutal onde cada momento testa sua coragem. Com apenas seu instinto, você consegue criar, construir e prosperar nesta aventura implacável de mundo aberto? Este jogo mobile de sobrevivência oferece ação eletrizante e possibilidades infinitas. Junte recursos, forme equipe com amigos e domine a selva—sua saga de sobrevivência começa agora!

SOBREVIVÊNCIA INTENSA

No Oxide: Survival Island, você é jogado em um mundo perigoso com três biomas únicos: frio, temperado e quente. Corte árvores, extraia rochas e cace predadores para enfrentar os elementos. Crie ferramentas, armas e abrigos para se proteger de ameaças, de animais selvagens a jogadores hostis. Isso não é apenas um simulador de sobrevivência—é uma luta feroz pela supremacia em um ambiente hostil. Você vai superar os perigos da ilha?

SOBREVIVÊNCIA MULTIJOGADOR

Sozinho ou em equipe—Oxide: Survival Island dá vida à sobrevivência multijogador. Use o sistema de amigos no jogo para se unir facilmente ao seu time, construir bases ou atacar inimigos juntos. Seja saqueando sozinho ou forjando alianças, a ação multijogador te prende. Enfrente outros sobreviventes, troque recursos ou declare guerra—a ilha é sua para conquistar!

CRIE, CONSTRUA, EXPLORE

Domine seu destino com um sistema de criação profundo. De machados rústicos a defesas robustas, cada item que você cria te aproxima da supremacia na sobrevivência. Construa bases imponentes ou acampamentos escondidos para reivindicar seu território. Explore um mapa expandido cheio de segredos, tesouros e perigos em paisagens diversas. Oxide: Survival Island combina o melhor dos simuladores de sobrevivência com a liberdade de um mundo aberto—perfeito para quem ama desafios de sobrevivência mobile.

ENFRENTE A FÚRIA DA ILHA

A ilha não tem piedade. Lute contra predadores, procure suprimentos e supere jogadores hostis em um mundo onde a sobrevivência nunca é garantida. Helicópteros patrulham os céus, adicionando um toque de imprevisibilidade, enquanto cada bioma—de picos gelados a planícies ardentes—desafia suas habilidades. Isso é mais que um jogo; é uma épica de sobrevivência mobile que exige astúcia e coragem.

POR QUE OXIDE?

— Biomas Dinâmicos: Conquiste zonas frias, temperadas e quentes.

— Sistema de Amigos: Junte-se ao seu time sem esforço.

— Sobrevivência Intensa: Enfrente o teste supremo de sobrevivência mobile.

— Mapa Expandido: Explore um mundo crescente cheio de surpresas.

— Atualizações Constantes: Novos eventos e melhorias anti-trapaça mantêm tudo fresco.

JUNTE-SE À ELITE DA SOBREVIVÊNCIA

Oxide: Survival Island é seu passe para uma aventura de sobrevivência de outro nível. Baixe agora e prove que você tem o que é preciso para reinar na ilha. Forje seu destino, sobreviva às adversidades e torne-se uma lenda neste épico jogo mobile de sobrevivência!

name: Sled Surfers – Corrida na Neve
description:
Mergulhe na aventura de inverno definitiva com Sled Surfers! Torne-se um verdadeiro piloto da neve ao deslizar por encostas geladas, desviar de obstáculos e correr por um mundo mágico e congelado repleto de ação. Deslize em seu trenó, surfe na neve e aprecie desafios rápidos inspirados pela diversão simples e imprevisível.
Corra por trilhas nevadas, domine curvas apertadas e desbloqueie equipamentos de inverno incríveis enquanto explora florestas congeladas, penhascos gelados e pistas escorregadias ladeira abaixo. Seja perseguindo a emoção de uma corrida na neve ou simplesmente desfrutando de um deslize relaxante de inverno, cada corrida é repleta de empolgação.
E se você ama o caos do verão nos jogos de tobogãs de parques aquáticos, você vai desfrutar do mesmo ritmo suave e viciante — só que com um toque gelado!

Recursos principais
Torne-se o piloto supremo da neve
 Surfe na neve, controle seu trenó e deslize por pistas invernais escorregadias
Jogabilidade rápida e divertida de corrida na neve
Acelere por caminhos congelados e desvie de obstáculos conforme a velocidade aumenta
Explore um mundo mágico e gélido
Descubra florestas congeladas, cavernas geladas e paisagens de inverno de tirar o fôlego
Desbloqueie trenós, personagens e equipamentos
Colete moedas para melhorar seu trenó e personalize sua aventura na neve
Power-Ups para uma descida mais rápida
Aumente sua velocidade com backflips e front flips no ar
Controles suaves
Fácil de jogar, infinitamente divertido e repleto de desafios surpreendentes

Pronto para surfar na neve?
Pegue seu trenó, dirija-se às encostas nevadas e comece sua aventura de inverno hoje! Seja você aqui pela emoção, pelo desafio ou pela atmosfera aconchegante do mundo gelado, Sled Surfers oferece diversão nevada sem fim.

name: Critical Strike: Jogo de tiro
description:
Critical Strike é um FPS multiplayer moderno de ritmo acelerado.
Você gosta das boas e velhas batalhas contra terroristas? Gosta jogos de tiro online e jogos de armas multiplayer? Este é o melhor jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa 3D em tempo real.

===JOGO===

* Torneio Corrida de Armas: Todas as armas são GRÁTIS. Modo de jogo competitivo para combater o ataque dos seus inimigos

* Sala privada: Chame seus amigos para jogar juntos na mesma sala.

===MAIS RECURSOS===
* Ótimos gráficos 3D e som, perfeitamente adaptado para Novos Jogos de Ação.
* Modo de batalha de até 5v5 PvP multiplayer online, luta justa!
* Use menos dados móveis em partidas em tempo real.
* Entre os melhores 10 jogos de tiro PvP FPS online!
* Muitas equipes para CT (SWAT, GIGN, Spetsnaz, Seal...)
* Muitas equipes para terroristas (Anarquista, Gangster, Balcãs...)

A melhor experiência de gráficos de tiro em primeira pessoa 3D deste ano vai fazer você aproveitar seu tempo jogando Critical Strike!
Se você está morto, não se esqueça de onde você foi atingido para contra-atacar e obter a sua vingança!
Junte-se ao combate competitivo no FPS portátil mais baseado em habilidades!
Se você sempre quis jogar um jogo de tiro multiplayer ótimo no seu dispositivo móvel, seus sonhos agora viraram realidade!
Você pode aproveitar os gráficos aprimorados e os efeitos sonoros incríveis deste jogo FPS online gratuito!

Jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa e jogo de tiro multiplayer feito com Unity para otimizar a experiência online FPS de arma.

name: Royal Kingdom

Você conhecerá o Rei Richard, irmão mais novo do Rei Robert, bem como um encantador elenco de novos personagens, incluindo a Princesa Bella e o Mago, e embarcará em uma jornada para construir reinos lendários! name: Sudoku - Sudoku Clássico
description:
Sudoku estimula o raciocínio! Mais de 5000+ desafiadores jogos de Sudoku todos os dias para treinar o seu cérebro, e adicionamos 100 novos quebra-cabeças toda semana. Brain Sudoku para os jogadores iniciantes e veteranos! Cada Sudoku possui apenas uma solução verdadeira. Classic Sudoku, o melhor jogo de quebra-cabeça para o seu cérebro, raciocínio lógico, memória e ÓTIMO PARA PASSAR O TEMPO!

Classic Sudoku é um jogo de raciocínio lógico com números, cujo objetivo é colocar dígitos de 1 a 9 em cada célula de cada quadrante de forma que cada um dos dígitos apareça apenas uma vez em cada linha, coluna e quadrante. Com nosso app de Sudoku, você pode não apenas aproveitar os jogos de sudoku quando e onde quiser, mas também aprender técnicas do jogo com ele. 

Principais Funções
Os quebra-cabeças de Sudoku possuem 4 níveis de dificuldade- fácil, médio, difícil e especialista! Perfeito para jogadores iniciantes e avançados em Sudoku!
Desafios Diários - Complete os Desafios Diários e colecione troféus. 
Modo Lápis - Ative ou desative o modo Lápis quando quiser.
Destacar Dígitos Repetidos - para evitar repetir os números em uma mesma linha, coluna ou bloco.
Dicas Inteligentes - seja guiado pelos números quando você estiver travado
Temas – Escolha o conjunto de cores que melhor se ajusta a sua vista.
Pressione e segure para preencher rapidamente


Neste app gratuito de Brain Sudoku, você também pode
Ligar / desligar os efeitos sonoros
Ativar / desativar o destaque para números idênticos
Remover automaticamente as notas de todas as colunas, linhas e blocos ao colocar o número
Ilimitadas opções para voltar & refazer
Auto-save - Pause o jogo e retorne de onde você parou sem perder o seu progresso
Sudoku online & Sudoku offline

Você pode gostar também das seguintes funções do Brain Sudoku
Você pode compartilhar com os seus amigos via Google+, Facebook, Twitter etc..
Use o modo noturno para proteger os seus olhos
Ative / desative o cronômetro quando você estiver jogando um sudoku
100 novos quebra-cabeças de sudoku toda semana.
Novos tipos de Sudoku, como o Killer Sudoku, Letter Sudoku, estarão disponíveis também.
Boa jogabilidade
Interface intuitiva
Ferramentas simples, fácil de controlar
Layout limpo


Nosso app gratuito de Sudoku possui uma interface intuitiva, fácil controle, layout limpo e níveis de dificuldade bem balanceados para jogadores iniciantes e veteranos. Ele é não apenas um ótimo quebra-cabeça para passar o tempo, mas também ajuda você a pensar, melhora o seu raciocínio lógico e a sua memória. 

Ao abrir nosso app Sudoku pela primeira vez, você poderá fazer um tour pelo jogo que ensinará a você como jogar Sudoku, e quando abrir o app pela 100ª vez, você pode se considerar um mestre de Sudoku e um excelente solucionador de quebra-cabeças. Você conseguirá jogar qualquer sudoku na web de forma ágil. Venha para o nosso Império do Sudoku e mantenha a sua mente afiada.

Este é o melhor app de sudoku para amantes desse quebra-cabeça. Se você gosta de jogar um bom sudoku, você definitivamente deve baixar o app Sudoku. Oferecemos 4 níveis de dificuldade. Adicionamos 100 novos quebra-cabeças toda semana. Baixe agora e jogue sudoku todos os dias.

description:

Junte-se a milhões de exploradores no universo do PK XD, um mundo aberto repleto de aventuras e possibilidades sem fim! CRIE JOGOS E EXPLORE UM MUNDO CHEIO DE DESAFIOS!

name: Castle Busters
description:
SMASH EVERY CASTLE. RULE EVERY ARENA.

Build your defenses, choose your crew, and smash your opponent's hard work to pieces in Castle Busters, a turn-based online PvP battle game.

Just you, your rival, and two castles that won't both survive the match intact. And you'd only just finished decorating!

MAKE EVERY SHOT COUNT

Take aim and fire. Your crew brought the firepower. Your opponent kindly supplied the target.

In fast 1v1 battles, every shot changes what happens next. Blast through walls to open new angles and collapse towers to expose enemy heroes. Win by taking out their entire crew or turning their castle into rubble.

With physics-based artillery and a battlefield that falls apart, you'll need to think on your feet. They can't hide behind a wall you've already demolished.

DRAFT YOUR CREW

Some heroes bring the damage. Others rally the crew to hit even harder. And some bring teammates back from the dead because nobody said they could leave yet.

Mix and match heroes whose abilities work together. Build around your favorites, discover powerful combinations, and find a crew that suits your playstyle.

YOUR CASTLE. YOUR DESIGN.

Build a castle worth showing off, then roll it into battle. Yes, it's on wheels.

Fortify your walls, position your heroes, and choose gadgets that suit your strategy. Test your setup in battle. Putting your plan together is almost as satisfying as watching theirs fall apart.

RAISE YOUR GAME

Level up your heroes and unlock new faces for your crew. Each new arrival brings a different ability to play with and another reason to rethink your lineup.

Earn rewards from the Forge as you upgrade your squad and stronghold. Who knew you could get rewarded for being such a destructive influence?

CLIMB THE RANKS

Earn trophies and progress through the arenas on Trophy Road. Unlock Ranked mode and compete on the leaderboards for rewards and bragging rights.

You'll need to outthink your rivals, not just outshoot them. The view from the top is lovely. Expect incoming fire.

The arena is open. Go break something.

FREE TO PLAY

Castle Busters is free to download and play. Some in-game items are available for purchase. A network connection is required. Suitable for players 13+.

name: Color Block: Combo Blast
description:
Color Block: a aventura definitiva do clássico quebra-cabeça de blocos

Reviva o clássico dos jogos de blocos — com um toque moderno!

Color Block é a fusão perfeita entre pensamento estratégico e diversão vibrante, levando a jogabilidade clássica de blocos que caem a uma nova dimensão de desafios. Este jogo gratuito foi feito para quem ama quebra-cabeças que estimulam o cérebro e garantem entretenimento sem fim.

Principais recursos de Color Block:
- Jogabilidade clássica de queda de blocos: Aproveite a sensação familiar dos blocos caindo, reinventada para uma nova geração.
- Domínio do quebra-cabeça: Coloque sua astúcia à prova com jogadas estratégicas para limpar linhas e acumular pontos.
- Jogos de blocos, reimaginados: A experiência clássica de “explosão de blocos” ganha um ar renovado — ideal para novatos e veteranos.
- Aventura que turbina o cérebro: Um treino mental que estimula suas habilidades cognitivas e afia a resolução de problemas.
- Desafio clássico: Mergulhe na nostalgia dos puzzles de blocos com um toque contemporâneo que prende do começo ao fim.
- Visuais deslumbrantes: Cores vibrantes e animações que fazem cada bloco ganhar vida.

Como jogar Color Block:
- Arrastar e soltar: Toque e mova os blocos para a grade 8x8 com controles intuitivos.
- Limpeza estratégica: Preencha linhas ou colunas para limpá-las e somar pontos.
- Criação de combos: Mantenha seus combos ativos limpando linhas em até três jogadas, elevando seu nível de habilidade.
- Blocos não rotacionáveis: Os blocos não giram, adicionando profundidade e exigindo planejamento com antecedência.

Dicas para se tornar um mestre do puzzle de blocos:
- Antecipe e planeje: Visualize vários lances à frente para montar cadeias de combos perfeitas.
- Otimize o espaço: Use a grade de forma inteligente para ampliar opções de colocação e criar mais chances de limpeza.
- Paciência é fundamental: Vá com calma; jogadas apressadas podem quebrar combos de alta pontuação.
- Adapte-se e supere: Ajuste sua estratégia conforme os padrões e os desafios evoluem ao longo da partida.

Embarque em uma jornada que estimula a mente e une o clássico ao moderno. Color Block combina a ação tradicional de blocos que caem com a diversão de resolver quebra-cabeças, oferecendo um desafio familiar com um frescor irresistível.

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

🔒Meus dados estão seguros com o Flo?

Sim. O programa de Privacidade e Segurança do Flo é premiado, e o Flo é o primeiro aplicativo de acompanhamento do ciclo menstrual certificado tanto na ISO 27001 quanto na ISO 27701, os padrões internacionais de excelência em proteção de dados.

- Modo anônimo: use o Flo sem que sua identidade seja vinculada às suas informações de saúde. Ninguém, nem mesmo nós, pode identificar você.
- Criptografia em todas as camadas: os mesmos padrões usados por bancos e órgãos governamentais.
- Transparência: nosso Trust & Safety Hub e a página de Privacidade e Segurança no aplicativo reúnem, em um só lugar, todas as informações essenciais que você precisa.

🌸Por que escolher o Flo para acompanhar a menstruação e a ovulação?

Mais que um calendário comum, este app de menstruação ajuda você a identificar os padrões do seu ciclo menstrual ao longo do tempo.

- Suporte para ciclos irregulares e atraso menstrual
- Resumos claros do que você registrou, para compartilhar com seu médico

O Flo oferece recursos educativos para você entender melhor seu ciclo menstrual e sua ovulação se você está tentando engravidar.

- Previsões da janela de ovulação, com base nos seus dados registrados
- Acompanhamento da temperatura corporal basal e do muco cervical

🐣Como o Flo acompanha minha gravidez semana a semana?

Após a concepção, use o Flo Gravidez para uma experiência estruturada, semana a semana.

- Monitor de gravidez semana a semana conforme seu bebê se desenvolve
- Imagens e diagramas que explicam as mudanças da gestação
- Conteúdo revisado por especialistas e histórias da comunidade

Acompanhe as mudanças dessa fase da vida com ferramentas dedicadas.

- Escore de Perimenopausa para explorar como os sintomas comuns podem afetar o dia a dia
- Fases da Menopausa para entender suas fases

💚O Flo é gratuito?

O Flo é gratuito para baixar, com todas as ferramentas essenciais para entender seu ciclo menstrual.

📚O que o Flo Premium oferece?

- Recursos de gravidez detalhados para cada fase, com gestação semana a semana

O Flo não oferece orientação médica, diagnóstico ou tratamento, e não é um método contraceptivo nem uma ajuda para a concepção. Consulte sempre um profissional ou uma profissional de saúde qualificado(a).

name: BlinkDas
summary: BlinkDas  is a casual game
description:
BlinkDas:

	A silver gust rolls across a meadow and weaves moving ripples through the grass. There is only one action: tap the screen to freeze the weave.

The pattern keeps cycling through three looks:

Forming: The ripples are incomplete and uneven. A tap here fails.
Aligned: The lattice is most regular and left-right symmetric. The hint reads The silver lattice is even and the center rings settle. Tap here for a perfect freeze.
Chaotic: The gust tangles the grass. A late tap fails.
Scoring:

Perfect freeze: You score, combo grows, and a faster gust begins. There is no final stage; the run continues until you mistime a freeze.
Early freeze: Broken, incomplete weave. The run ends.
Late freeze: Tangled, chaotic weave. The run ends.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap any bottle to pick up the top ball, then tap another bottle to move the ball into it.
- You can only stack the ball into a bottle with the same color ball on top and enough space.

- Each bottle can only be placed with 4 balls.

name: Oxide: Survival Island
summary: Multiplayer survival simulator on abandoned island: survival action with friends
description:
Oxide: Survival Island is a hard online survival simulator. It is a sandbox world with real players. You wake up on a dangerous shore with nothing. This is island survival. Cold, hunger, animals, and enemies can kill you fast. Every server is a shared world. It keeps running even when you leave.

Play on your own servers. Your progress is saved. You can return later and continue. One server can host many players. That makes the world feel alive. You will meet builders, raiders, and clans. You can fight them or work with them. This is a true massively multiplayer survival experience. Many players look for rust survival vibes on mobile. This game gives that tense loop: gather, craft, build, defend, repeat.

Explore a big island of survival. Go through woods and coastal areas. Travel along the ocean and shore. Visit the gas station and enemy bases. Search loot barrels for supplies. The map is larger and more open. It gives you space to hide, scout, and attack. It also gives enemies more places to ambush you. Each run can feel like a lost island story.

You can play solo. You can also play with others. Try multiplayer survival games with friends. Invite them to the same server. Add them to your friends list. See when they are online. This makes teamwork simple. Build together and protect each other. That is co-op survival. If you like coop survival games, you can share roles. One player farms resources. One crafts weapons. One scouts and guards the base. These are coop survival games built by real players. For many fans, it feels like rust survival multiplayer, but designed for phones.

Collect wood, stone, and metal. Craft tools and gear. Craft weapons and ammo. The game has many weapon types. The crafting system is improved. The building system is improved too. Start with a small shelter. Turn it into a strong base. Place walls, doors, and storage. Create a safe area and defend it.

Use the cupboard system to protect your base. Craft a cupboard and place it inside. Put logs in it often. This slows down decay. It also helps you keep control of your home area. Without it, your house will weaken over time.

Survive in three biomes. Some zones are cold. Some are temperate. Some are hot. Craft attire for protection. Clothing helps against damage. It also helps against cold. Watch your food and water. Hunt animals for meat. Cook and store supplies. Manage your inventory and plan long trips.

Travel by land and by sea. The ocean is not only scenery. It is part of the danger and the route. Fans of sea adventure games will enjoy moving along the coast. You can scout bases from the water. You can move loot between points. The sea can also hide enemies. Storms and long routes add pressure. This is where island survival feels the most tense.

Fight for resources. Defend your base. Raid other bases. Make allies if you want. Betrayal is possible too. Each server becomes a contest for control. This is last survival. Only the strongest teams last. Master land survival, learn the map, and get better gear. Build smart, craft fast, and stay alert.

If you search for rust mobile, you want a tough survival sandbox on your phone. If you search for rust in mobile, you want raids, bases, and real players. Oxide brings that style with persistent servers, crafting, and open-world fights. It is a mobile answer for rust survival, with the freedom of a sandbox and the pressure of multiplayer survival.

Enjoy improved sky graphics and day-night changes. Watch the horizon, track threats, and survive the island.

name: CNH do Brasil
summary: Digital driver's license and vehicle registration certificate, first driver's license, traffic violation and vehicle information.
description:
The Brazilian CNH app is the evolution of the Digital Traffic Wallet (CDT), which started as the Digital CNH. With the app, you can access your digital documents - National Driver's License (CNH) and Vehicle Registration and Licensing Certificate (CRLV) - in a practical and secure way, directly from your cell phone.

In addition, those who are not yet licensed can start the process of obtaining their First Driver's License through the app itself, making everything simpler and more accessible.

The Digital CNH and the Digital CRLV are the digital versions of the National Driver's License (CNH) and the Vehicle Registration and Licensing Certificate (CRLV) with the same legal value as their respective printed versions.

The digital versions offer additional advantages that provide greater mobility, practicality and convenience through:

- Ease of sharing information (export to PDF with digital signature in the ICP-Brasil standard with legal validity according to MP 2.200-2/2001). This avoids printing and/or scanning documents, as well as eliminating the need for notarization;

- Have your authenticity, reliability, and integrity easily validated through the Vio app. To do this, simply download the Vio app and point the reader at the QR Code of your digital document.

For more information, visit:

Frequently Asked Questions:

https://portalservicos.senatran.serpro.gov.br/#/ajuda/faq/cnh-do-brasil

Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, new and old. Build a block city, start a farm, mine deep underground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination in this expansive simulation!
 
Craft a new house, build a block city, or start a farm. Bring your imagination to life and build your dream avatar world where the possibilities are endless. Adventure through your own online game and play with friends, building from the ground up in our crafting simulation. In Creative mode, enjoy unlimited resources and the freedom of superior building and crafting. In Survival mode, survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer games with friends on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends and discover an infinite, randomly generated game 3D world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle) in a universe of crafting!

BUILD YOUR DREAM WORLD
• Build a block city, a house, or create an entire game world from the ground up
• Building simulator games for kids, adults, or anyone

MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES

• Multiplayer game servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account
• Explore endless realms through multiplayer games with friends. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you

• Enjoy crafting buildings, building gigantic community-run worlds, competing in unique mini-games, and socializing in lobbies full of fellow Minecraft block builders

description:

Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.

You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.

Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...

MASSIVE OPEN WORLD

Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?

ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM

Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.

Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.

BEAUTIFUL VISUALS

Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.

SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK

Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards.

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS

Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!

name: Rise of Kingdoms: Lost Crusade

description:
Shape Your Civilization with 180,000,000+ Players Worldwide!
What if ancient China and ancient Rome went to war? When Julius Caesar clashes with Cao Cao on the same battlefield, who shall emerge victorious?
What does it feel like to play a war strategy game that fuses MOBA and RTS mechanics, featuring multiplayer competition and real-time combat?
What stories will unfold in a vast world shared by over 80,000 players, free to explore, gather, create, build, and battle?
Find the answer in Rise of Kingdoms, a battlefield unlike anything you have experienced before.

▶FEATURES◀
15 Unique Civilizations
Choose one of 15 historical civilizations and guide your empire from a lone clan into a great, unstoppable force! Each civilization has its own architecture, unique units, and special advantages — how you utilize them is up to you!

Real-Time Battles
Battles happen in real time on the map. Anyone can join or leave a battle at any time, allowing true RTS gameplay. See an ally being attacked right in your backyard? Send some troops to help your buddy out, or launch a surprise counterattack on the attacker’s city.

Seamless World Map
All in-game action takes place on a single, enormous map inhabited by players and NPCs. No isolated bases or separate battle screens. Never before seen on mobile “infinite zoom” allows you to transition freely between the world view and individual cities or barbarian outposts. Map features include natural obstructions such as rivers and mountain ranges and strategic passes that must be captured to gain entrance to neighboring regions.

Exploration & Investigation
Your world is covered in thick fog. Dispatch scouts to explore this mysterious land and uncover the hidden treasure within.
Investigate lost temples, barbarian fortresses, mysterious caves, and tribal villages, gather intelligence on your enemies, and prepare yourself for the ultimate battle!

Unrestricted Troop Movements
New orders can be issued to troops at any time, offering limitless strategic possibilities. Launch an attack on an enemy city, then circle back and meet up with your alliance army to capture a pass.
Dispatch troops to collect lumber from a nearby forest and have them pick off a few barbarian clans along the way. Forces can also be split up between multiple commanders so that you can engage in multiple actions simultaneously.

Alliance System
Full alliance features allow players to help one another: live chat with built-in translation, officer roles, map indicators to coordinate strategies, and more! Alliances can expand their territory to gain resources, capture mountain passes and barbarian outposts to strengthen their position, and work together to unlock group achievements.

Conquer the Kingdom
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of this vast kingdom. Clash with other players and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in a MMO strategy battle royale. Rise to the top and you and your civilization will be written down in your kingdom’s history!

RPG Commanders
Call upon dozens of historical figures who will serve as your trustworthy commanders, from Julius Caesar and Sun Tzu to Joan of Arc and Kusunoki Masashige. Level up your commanders by defeating barbarians and sending them into battles, then upgrade their abilities using an RPG style talent tree and skill system.

summary: Climb out of the streets and take command of Narco Empire
description:
Pull yourself up from the gutter and take control of the underground in Narco Empire. Step into a raw, cinematic underbelly of secret labs, risky shipments, and bloody turf clashes — every choice about trust, risk, and ambition pushes you from a nobody on the block to a leader people fear.

From corner deals to the throne
Begin with small trades and tough calls. Make allies, collect favors, and turn tiny wins into real standing. As your influence grows, neighborhoods fall under your control, and each decision opens new chances — and new dangers.

Run the underground supply
Hunt down scarce materials across contested blocks and hide workshops that slowly turn into full operations. Close-up, hands-on lab scenes let you sharpen your product and raise its value on the black market. Improve how you work, bring in trusted hands, and scale from cramped benches to full factories.

Plot dangerous smuggling runs
Plan routes, prepare convoys, and react fast when things break down. Send guarded loads through hostile zones, pick stealth or force, bribe contacts, or sabotage rival narco crews — and always watch for checkpoints. Each successful run opens new trade corridors and extends your reach.

Turn goods into clout
Use distribution to build power: run street deals, land big wholesale contracts, and launder dirty cash into a respectable front. Oversee retail chains, pressure or partner with rivals, and plant investments that keep your empire hidden from view.

Keep the crown — and survive
Power draws betrayal. One mistake can wipe everything out. Recruit loyal lieutenants, sharpen your enforcers, and flush out moles before they strike. Diplomacy, threats, and targeted strikes are all in your playbook — but loyalties can flip overnight. Will you rule from the shadows, or become just another name in a police file?

name: Castle Busters
summary: Real-time 1v1 PvP strategy brawler. Smash castles, siege towers, rule arena!
description:
Castle Busters is a real-time 1v1 PvP strategy game where your castle is your weapon. Draft your units, blast through destructible walls, and crush rival players in fast online multiplayer battles.

No scripted waves. No waiting. Just you, your rival, and a castle that won't survive the match intact.

⚔️ BREAK EVERY WALL. RULE EVERY ARENA.
Your castle isn't just your base, it's your weapon. Every wall you destroy opens a new angle. Every floor you collapse exposes an enemy. In Castle Busters, the battlefield falls apart in real time, and the player who reads it best wins.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE CASTLE BUSTERS

🏰 Fully destructible castles. Blast holes through walls to create firing lines and collapse floors to drop enemy units. No two PvP matches ever play out the same way.
⚡ Real-time 1v1 PvP. Fast online multiplayer matches packed with tactical decisions where every shot counts and every second of hesitation hands your rival a new opening.
🛡️ Build your loadout. Draft up to 8 unique units: knights, archers, bombers and siege engines. Each one changes how you attack, the angles you threaten, and how you defend your keep.
📈 Deep upgrades. Level up units, unlock new perks, and reinforce the parts of your castle that matter most. The longer you play, the sharper your arsenal gets.
🏆 Ranked arenas. Climb from Bronze to Legend and battle real players on seasonal leaderboards.
🔥 The Forge. Earn epic rewards by upgrading your squad and stronghold. The deeper you go, the meaner the meta gets.
🎯 Play your way. Precision snipes, brute-force sieges, decoy walls or collapse traps. Every strategy can win if you execute it right.

CORE GAMEPLAY
Aim and fire from inside your castle using your drafted units. The walls between you and your enemy aren't obstacles, they're opportunities. Destroy supports to collapse towers onto enemy positions. Carve a sightline through three floors to land a shot no one saw coming. Bait your opponent into breaking through where they shouldn't. In Castle Busters, defense is never passive. It's a trap.

Win by wiping out all enemy units, or by turning their castle into rubble. Arena hazards shift your angles and destructible terrain means every PvP battle is a puzzle that builds itself in real time.

DRAFT YOUR ARMY
Knights to break the front line. Archers to punish exposed units. Bombers to crack open walls and towers. Siege engines to flatten whole sections of an enemy castle. Mix and match up to 8 units into a loadout that fits your playstyle: patient and surgical, or fast and chaotic. Then upgrade each unit to unlock power spikes that open entirely new ways to play and clash.

META AND PROGRESSION
Your units grow with you. Level them up to unlock new perks, power spikes and fresh tactical options. Your castle evolves too. Reinforce the walls and towers that matter most, then test your build in multiplayer PvP. Ranked ladders and arenas introduce new obstacles, tighter matchups and fresh unit unlocks the deeper you climb. At the top of every leaderboard are players who have spent hundreds of hours perfecting their builds. You'll need to outthink them, not just outshoot them.

WHO IT'S FOR
If you love real-time strategy games, 1v1 PvP duels, tower-and-castle warfare, or fast online multiplayer battles you can finish in a few minutes, Castle Busters is built for you. Easy to pick up, hard to master, and impossible to play the same way twice.

BUILD. BREAK. REPEAT.
Some builds are patient. Some are pure chaos. None of them are wrong if they win the battle. Draft your squad, fortify your keep, sharpen your aim. The arena is open. Go break something.

FREE TO PLAY
Castle Busters is free to download and play. Some in-game items are available for purchase. A network connection is required. Suitable for players 13+.

summary: Hook monsters in the sand, earn XP, upgrade gear and grow in an idle action RPG.
description:
Enter Butcher Hero, an idle action RPG where every enemy becomes fuel for your next upgrade. Explore hostile sand zones, throw your chain hook, pull monsters and aliens into range, earn XP, and devour their power to build a stronger hero.

Hook, devour, grow

Aim the hook, drag in your target, and finish the fight. Each hunt earns XP and turns captured power into permanent upgrades for damage, attack speed, armor, or health. Choose what to improve and shape a build that can survive tougher zones.

Build your RPG hero

Collect gear and tune your loadout for the challenge ahead. Combine equipment with permanent stats, unlock new ways to fight, and upgrade your hero as enemies become stronger. Make meaningful build choices and keep leveling up.

If you enjoy RPG games and progression-focused adventure games, every hunt gives you a clear upgrade choice and a stronger build to take into the next fight.

Action and idle progression

Butcher Hero combines the quick decisions of action games with the steady growth of idle games. Fans of incremental games can start a short hunt, improve permanent stats, and push into a harder zone. Every choice moves your build forward.

Keep building your hero with AFK progression, or use auto-battle when you want a lighter session. Return to choose upgrades, tune your gear, and decide how to tackle the next fight.

Monster survival in the sand

Push through sand-covered areas filled with creatures, elite enemies, and dangerous aliens. Fans of survival games can focus on armor and health, while aggressive builds lean into damage and speed. Adapt your loadout and keep moving as every area raises the pressure.

Win boss battles

Face massive bosses with distinct attacks and rising difficulty. Learn each encounter, improve your gear, and return stronger. Climb the Boss Tower to see how far your build can go and earn rewards from demanding boss battles.

Complete quests and claim rewards

Finish quests, gather crystals, and open chests for resources that help your hero grow. Develop the Soul Graph, reinforce your favorite stats, and create a loadout ready for the next challenge.

Play offline or enter PvP

Fans of offline games can play the complete single-player adventure without an internet connection. When connected, test your build against other heroes in PvP battles. PvP is separate from offline single-player play.

Play your way

• Chain-hook combat built around pulling enemies into range
• Devour power and turn every hunt into permanent growth
• Upgrade damage, speed, armor, and health
• Collect gear and customize your loadout
• Fight monsters, aliens, elite enemies, and giant bosses
• Climb the Boss Tower and complete quests
• Earn crystals, open chests, and improve the Soul Graph
• Make progress with AFK progression and optional auto-battle
• Enjoy the complete single-player game offline
• Challenge other heroes in online PvP

Start small, hunt smarter, and become the hero no monster can stop. Hook the enemy, steal its power, upgrade your build, and turn every fight into permanent growth.

name: Sword x Staff
summary: Welcome to the world of Kanstein, where your adventure is what you make it!
description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！ 
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world] 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in] 
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind] 
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring] 
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same] 
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

summary: Lead ants, sort colorful cubes, and unlock beautiful pixel art puzzles!
description:
🐜 Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

🧠 COMMAND YOUR COLONY

👆 Tap a box to send its ants marching
🧱 Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
🕳️ Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
🔓 Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
✅ Clear every block to finish the puzzle

🎯 EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

👆 One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
🧩 Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
⏳ No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
🐜 Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
🖼️ Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

🎨 DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals 🐘, fruit 🍓, food 🍜, flowers 🌸, nature 🌿, festivals 🎉, toys 🧸, rockets 🚀, castles 🏰, and plenty more surprises. Every puzzle you finish adds another piece of pixel art to your collection, so there's always one more picture waiting to be uncovered.

name: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redu
summary: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux - Post-Apocalyptic Action Shooter
description:
Survive deadly combat and stealth in the poisoned wasteland of Chernobyl Zone. Play as Serioga, lead your people to safety in the old subway tunnels, and fight for survival in this immersive post-apocalyptic world.

Long Description:

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is an epic, story-driven first person post-apocalyptic shooter from AGaming+. In 2014, an apocalypse destroyed most of humanity and turned the Earth's surface into a poisoned wasteland. It's now 2034, and as the surface of the Earth freezes, people must seek shelter in the old subway tunnels.

You play as Serioga, a survivor born just before the apocalypse, who must lead your people to safety and fight for survival against terrifying enemies. Explore the dangerous world, scavenge for resources, and engage in deadly combat and stealth.

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is one of the most immersive game worlds ever created, with stunning graphics and realistic sound effects. Can you survive and lead your people to safety? Play Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux now and find out.

name: Vector Classic
summary: Join the breathtaking chase!
description:
Parkour-inspired action game is now available! Vector lets you break free and run! Don't get caught!

Vector is an exciting, arcade-style game featuring you as the exceptional free runner who won’t be held down by the system. The game opens with a view into a totalitarian world where freedom and individually is nothing more than a distant dream. But the heart of a freerunner is strong, and you soon break free. Run, vault, slide and climb using extraordinary techniques based on the urban ninja sport of Parkour all while being chased by “Big Brother” who’s sole purpose is to capture you and bring you back.

Inspired by the practice and principles of Parkour, Vector’s intuitive controls please players of all levels, and sophisticated level designs challenge the most demanding players with fast-paced timing puzzles as the traceur “flows” over the dystopian rooftops.

Game Features:
- Arcade gameplay from the makers of the Shadow Fight games
- Astoundingly lifelike Parkour-inspired moves made possible by Cascadeur animation tools
- 40+ challenging levels
- Quick to learn, challenging to master

name: Bike Mayhem Mountain Racing
summary: Rip down tons of mountains while busting tricks on your custom bike!
description:
Downhill mountain bike racing like never before. Race down beautiful trails, smashing over rocks and roots, boosting huge jumps, scoring insane trick combos, unlocking better bikes and gear for bragging rights as the King of the Mountain!

The best mobile bike game, Bike Mayhem Extreme Mountain Racing! 

Compete in timed races or freestyle trick events on 19 different mountains and over 100 trails inspired by real world locations.

Unlock over 80 items of gear to add style your rider and tune your bike for speed, agility, strength, and energy for each trail.

Experience realistic physics and plush bike suspension as your bike eats up the rough stuff and softens the landings of big jumps and drops. 
High speeds and big jumps means huge crashes where your rider will ragdoll tumble down the trail. Use your finger to pick up you rider throw him even further.

Share your races with your friends. Challenge them to beat your times! 

Brought to you by the makers of the epically popular Motocross racing game: Moto X Mayhem, which reached #1 Paid App worldwide and was a Top 5 Racing game for over a year! 

FEATURES: 

- 100+ Beautiful mountain trails for all styles of riding
- 80+ Gear items for your rider and MTB bike 
- Frame and wheel upgrades that impact game play
- Epic bike crashes, fun rag doll physics and active bike suspension
- Tricks, bunny hops and flips! 
- Addictive gameplay 
- Powerful online leaderboards

TIPS: 

- If you use check points, you will get a maximum of one star. Stay on your bike to achieve 3 stars! 
- Lean to add flips into your trick combo. 
- Wheelie into and out of a jump to add to your trick combo.
- Hold down the pump/hop button when entering a downhill section to get a boost in speed.
- Wheelies do not drain your energy
- The timer doesn't start until you start to pedal the bike or brake! 
- Use your finger to grab the rider and toss him around the map when you're on or off the bike. 
- Make sure you pick the right frame and wheel combination to get the best score for each trail.
-Use boosters to help you through a difficult trail or to get the top position on the leaderboard.

name: Poppy Playtime Chapter 1
summary: The Official Poppy Playtime Mobile Game!
description:
You must stay alive in this horror/puzzle adventure. Try to survive the vengeful toys waiting for you in the abandoned toy factory. Use your GrabPack to hack electrical circuits or nab anything from afar. Explore the mysterious facility... and don't get caught.

Welcome to Playtime Co.!
Playtime Co. was once the king of the toy manufacturing industry... until everybody inside of the factory one day disappeared into thin air. Now, years later, you must explore the abandoned factory and uncover the truth.

The Toys
The toys of Playtime Co. are a lively bunch! From Bot to Huggy, Catbee to Poppy, Playtime does it all! As long as you're at Playtime Co., why not pay the toys a little visit? You might just make a few friends...

name: Blasphemous
summary: Brutal action-platformer
description:
Fight. Endure. Break eternal damnation.

Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffering.

Set in the cursed land of Cvstodia, ravaged by a twisted curse known only as The Miracle, you play as The Penitent One, the last survivor of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, bound to a cycle of death and rebirth.

Face monstrous enemies, navigate deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets in pixel perfect handcrafted levels. As you fight for redemption, you'll explore desolate cathedrals, forsaken wastelands, and blood-soaked dungeons, encountering grotesque monsters, merciless bosses and tormented souls along the way.

Penance Never Ends.

MAIN FEATURES
- Explore a Non-Linear World: Venture through diverse platformer environments filled with fearsome enemies and deadly traps. Seek redemption across the dark gothic landscapes of Cvstodia.
- Brutal Action Combat: Wield Mea Culpa, a blade forged from guilt itself. Unleash devastating combos and skills, and hack and slash your way through hordes of twisted monsters.
- Executions & gore: Deliver savage executions with pixel perfect animations that celebrate brutal combat and grotesque detail.
- Customise Your Build: Equip powerful Relics, Rosary Beads, Prayers, and Sword Hearts to shape your playstyle. Experiment with builds and unlock new progression paths to survive the impossible.
- Intense boss Battles: Face off against colossal bosses and deadly mini-bosses. Learn their patterns, endure their fury, and crush them.
- Unlock the Mysteries of Cvstodia: Meet a cast of tortured NPCs. Some will help, others will test your resolve. Unravel their stories and shape your fate in blood, guilt and damnation.

ALL DLCs INCLUDED
This mobile version includes all free DLCs ever released for Blasphemous, expanding the core game with new content, features, and challenges:
- The Stir of Dawn – Unlock New Game+, encounter new bosses and enemies, and dive deeper into the lore.
- Strife & Ruin – Brave the brutal Boss Rush mode and embark on a crossover quest with Miriam from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night.
- Wounds of Eventide – Witness the conclusion of The Penitent One’s first journey and unlock an ending that connects directly to Blasphemous 2.

THE FULL BLASPHEMOUS EXPERIENCE – NOW ON MOBILE
- Includes every feature and content update from the original PC and console versions. Switch between precise touch controls or full controller support (gamepad compatible) for a seamless experience.
- No ads, no microtransactions.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
summary: No place to run, and exactly one place to hide.
description:
NOTE: Remastered version from the PC version. A device with at least 2 GB of RAM is required for this game to run properly.

Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza!

In Five Nights at Freddy's 2, the old and aging animatronics are joined by a new cast of characters. They are kid-friendly, updated with the latest in facial recognition technology, tied into local criminal databases, and promise to put on a safe and entertaining show for kids and grown-ups alike!

What could go wrong?

As the new security guard working nights, your job is to monitor cameras and make sure nothing goes wrong after-hours. The previous guard has complained about the characters trying to get into the office (he has since been moved to day-shift). So to make your job easier, you've been provided with your very own empty Freddy Fazbear head, which should fool the animatronic characters into leaving you alone if they should accidentally enter your office.

As always, Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.

NOTE: Interface and audio in English. Subtitles in English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish (Latin America), Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Korean.

name: Bloons TD 6
summary: Smash Hit Tower Defense Game
description:
Craft your perfect defense from a combination of powerful Monkey Towers and awesome Heroes, then pop every last invading Bloon!

Over a decade of tower defense pedigree and regular massive updates makes Bloons TD 6 a favorite game for millions of players. Enjoy endless hours of strategy gaming with Bloons TD 6!

* Regular updates! We release several updates every year with new characters, features, and gameplay.

name: Max Payne Mobile
summary: Max Payne, the award-winning title is now available for Android mobile devices.
description:
Max Payne, the award-winning title is now available for Android mobile devices.

A fugitive undercover cop framed for murder, hunted by cops and the mob, Max is a man with his back against the wall, fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. Max Payne is a relentless story-driven game about a man on the edge, fighting to clear his name while struggling to uncover the truth about his slain family amongst a myriad of plot-twists. 

The groundbreaking original cinematic action-shooter, Max Payne introduced the concept of Bullet Time® in videogames. Through its stylish slow-motion gunplay combined with a dark and twisted story, Max Payne redefined the action-shooter genre.

Max Payne Mobile for Android has been fully optimized for the NVIDIA® Tegra® 3 quad-core mobile processor with additional antistrophic texture filtering and enhanced lighting effects providing one of the most visually immersive Max Payne Mobile experiences available.

name: My Child Lebensborn
summary: Help your child, in a story-driven parenting game based on true events.
description:
You adopt a young Lebensborn child in Norway after WW2, but parenting will be hard as your child grows up in a hostile and hateful environment. 
Can you help Klaus/Karin cope with the heavy inheritance of the German occupation, so they will find their place in a country that is celebrating its freedom?

Polygon: "My Child Lebensborn tells a disturbing tale about innocents in the aftermath of WW2”
LevelUp: “The strongest game experience that I have ever had.”

My Child Lebensborn is a BAFTA-winning parenting simulation with original gameplay and a heartbreaking story. It has challenged millions of players to experience how hard it is to keep a child safe when they are seen as symbols of a hated enemy.

See a different side of the war, inspired by the true stories of the Lebensborn children. Discover how hatred of our enemies continues to create victims, even after victory. Discover their past and support them in the present. You must balance your time and resources to provide for your child. You will find answers to the hard questions; about their history, the hatred, bullying and the passing of blame.

Feed, clothe, teach, and comfort your child as you navigate the prejudices of a hostile community. Every decision shapes who they become.

You can make a difference.

Key Features:
- Adopt a boy or girl, and support them through a defining year of their life.
- Influence the child’s feelings, personality and worldview through your choices.
- Earn money as you work, then cook, craft, forage and play.
- Use your time and meagre resources wisely.
- Look for the effects of your choices in your child’s expressions and body language.
- Explore a gripping storyline based upon true events.

Parts of the game's proceeds are donated to help protect Children Born of War (children born of enemy soldiers and local women).

This game presents difficult and heavy topics, not suitable for young children.

If you loved caring for Karin or Klaus in this game, you can continue with them in the sequel "My Child New Beginnings".

For technical support, please contact us at support@sareptastudio.com

name: Farming Simulator 23 Mobile
summary: Grow your agricultural empire with 100+ authentic machines!
description:
Grow crops, grow your agricultural empire! Become a modern farmer to operate more than 100 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world - offering a wide range of farming activities. 

Choose what kind of farmer you want to be in Farming Simulator 23 (FS23) as the acclaimed agricultural sim by GIANTS Software offers a brand-new experience with many new features for your mobile device!

Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and more
Cultivate fields with a variety of crops, or harvest grapes and olives on the hillside
Start logging with heavy forestry equipment 
Establish production chains and use powerful trucks for transport
Tend to farm animals like cows, sheep, and now: chickens!
Enjoy tons of possibilities on two new maps, including collectibles
New gameplay features also introduce plowing and weeding
A tutorial mode, AI helper & a new autoload feature for logs/pallets assist you on your farm 

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry - there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. If more than 100 machines are not enough, you can grow your fleet of agricultural vehicles through official extra content.

New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life. Start farming wherever you go and let the good times grow!

Farming Simulator 23 will be released on May 23, 2023, and is the latest official game in the successful simulation series available for mobile devices.

name: Balatro
summary: When Poker Meets Solitaire
description:
Welcome to the official Balatro game!

Your goal is to beat Boss Blinds by making strong poker hands. 
Find new Jokers that change the game and create awesome and exciting combos! Take on challenging bosses, discover wild poker hands and unlock new decks as you play. 

You’ll need all the help you can get to beat the big boss, win the final challenge, and win the game.

Features:

* Remastered controls for touch screen devices; now even more satisfying!
* Each run is different: every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.
* Multiple game items: discover over 150 Jokers, each with special powers. Use them with different decks,upgrade cards and vouchers to boost your scores.
* Different Game modes: Campaign mode and challenge mode for you to play.

name: Ultimate Custom Night
summary: Welcome to the ultimate FNaF mashup!
description:
NOTE: A device with at least 2 GB of RAM is required for this game to run properly.

Welcome to the ultimate FNaF mashup, where you will once again be trapped alone in an office fending off killer animatronics! Featuring 50 selectable animatronic characters spanning seven Five Nights at Freddy's games, the options for customization are nearly endless. Mix and match any assortment of characters that you like, set their difficulty from 0-20, then jump right into the action! From your office desk, you will need to manage two side doors, two vents, as well as two air hoses, all of which lead directly into your office.

This time you will have to master other tools as well if you want to complete the ultimate challenges, tools such as the heater, A/C, a global music box, a power generator, and more. As if all of that weren't enough, you'll also need to set up laser traps in the vents, collect Faz-Coins, purchase items from the Prize Counter, and as always, keep a close eye on not one, but two Pirate Cove curtains!

Other features also included:
- Challenge menu including 16 themed challenges

- Unlockable office skins

name: Survival Island: Evolve Pro
summary: Survival has become even more difficult, dangerous and exciting!
description:
Many centuries have passed before the humanity has finally achieved its long awaited goal – we have conquered the Earth and enslaved the nature forces. But you know how they say, the bigger they are – the harder they fall. Eventually we did fall and it was hard. Environmental cataclysm exploded, covering every major city in toxic smog, the atmosphere became less and less livable with each passing day, the Earth’s light started to decay. The only way of delaying the inevitable turned out to be a special emulsion obtained out of the rarest metal Pridium. The Earth Protection Committee formed a special task force in order to discover new worlds rich in Pridium. You stepped up as a volunteer and departed for the unexplored territory but as it usually happens, something went wrong. You woke up on an island with no team, no water or food, no clothes and only with a dull head and a heap of questions. You must survive by all means and get back home. It won’t be easy so get going and good luck!

Game features:
* Explore the wilderness! 
* Build your house from the ground up!
* Utilize an extensive crafting system with tons of recipes
* Meet the island fauna! 
* Island survival sandbox simulator

name: Metal Soldiers 4 Pro
summary: The war escalates! Battle through enemy lines with powerful heroes.
description:
🚀 Limited-time launch offer!
Get ready for the ultimate action experience! Metal Soldiers 4 PRO takes the war to a whole new level. Lock and load your weapons and face the challenge in this definitive premium version.

⭐⭐ THE PRO ADVANTAGE ⭐⭐ Play without limits. This version is designed for players who want the complete experience:

fighting⚔️ Unlock New Heroes You are not alone. Save and unlock a cast of unique characters, each ready to join the fight against the enemy hordes.
